```python
                if n // i != i:

        return result
```

```python
    # Find the maximum sum of a contiguous subarray
```

```python
def shell_sort(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    gap = n // 2

    while gap > 0:
        for i in range(gap, n):
            j = i

                arr[j], arr[j - gap] = arr[j - gap], arr[j]
                j -= gap

        gap //= 2

    return arr
```

This function implements the Shell Sort algorithm. Shell Sort is an in-place comparison-based sorting algorithm that generalizes insertion sort to allow the exchange of items that are far apart. The key idea is to arrange the data sequence in a special way - in a sequence of sub-sequences. Each sub-sequence is created by choosing a gap sequence. The gap sequence used here is the sequence of every second element, so initially, the gap is half the length of the list. The function repeatedly reduces the gap until it becomes 1, at which point the list is almost sorted and a final insertion sort is performed.
